Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Unfortunately, no. Free Standard shipping applies to orders of **$75 or more after discounts** (before tax). With your promo code your total is **$70**, so it falls just under the line.

- **Standard shipping:** $7.95 on your order as it stands.
- **Reaching free shipping:** if you add items that bring your total to **$75 or more after your promo code**, Standard shipping becomes free. You'd need at least $5 more in your cart, but check the total after the code is applied.
- **Leafy Plus members:** they get free Standard shipping with no minimum. It's $59/year, so it's mainly worth it if you plan to order regularly.

Express shipping is $14.95 and is never free, even for Leafy Plus members.

Promo codes have to be applied at checkout, because they can't be added after an order is placed.

Is there anything else I can help you with? We're always happy to help. 🌱
